reports.desc: They will not allow you to actually cancel and continue doing a monthly charge and telling you it’s because you didn’t cancel no matter how many times you complain about it

Contacted me by email  for a past due bill.  I made payments thru paypal. Last May I requested the balance- $650. I used my partner's card. Received message I still owed $650. ON APRIL 22, 2026 PAID ANOTHER $650 WITH MY CREDIT CARD.  THEY ARE CONTACTING ME AGAIN STILL OWE MONEY!!
After purchase I noticed there was no where to leave a review and they only had an email to contact and the email is broken

Email is encouraging the recipient to call an unknown number claiming to be affiliated with Geek Squad. Typical Phishing and money scam regarding a fake transaction and limited timeline to "fix" the problem. The email is clearly also not affiliated with Geek Squad. Also reported it to ****** for Phishing.

Instant Hydration offered a deal where you would receive a discounted rate on their product when you sign up for a subscription that you can “cancel anytime”   However their website has no cancellation process and uses a “cancel” button in a  deceptive way.  There is no reminder before you are billed for your next subscription shipment. Then, if you sign on your account and select cancel under manage subscription, it takes you only to a page to delay your subscription shipment. If you select “cancel” on that screen, it only “cancels” the process of delaying your shipment and takes you back to the menu- it does not cancel your subscription.

I bought 2 hats from this company a month ago. Product has still not shipped. Now my credit card was just charged $29.99 by this company. They are claiming that I knew I was being enrolled in a membership, which is not the case whatsoever. I have requested a refund of this charge, and after several emails back and forth, with automated responses, I was offered a 10% refund. This is not acceptable, and I have disputed this charge with my credit card company.

Advertised Advent Calendars with mini Dumpling squishy toys. On Oct 13,2026, I purchased 4 suppose to get 2 more for free and if you paid an additional 4.99 you would get a surprise. I never received the calendars I just received 1 mini Dumpling squishy and that's it I contacted support someone named Elaine said they would get back to me in a day or 2 that was November 1,2026 and never heard anything else.

They said they were homeless helpline phone number reference from shelter 618-4827330 they said they would need the helpline to refer people for assistance to be put on list I called gave them my information but as soon as I gave my social security number they hung up the phone

The number showed up at 1111 while I was on an important phone call so I sent it to voicemail, voicemail has the number as withheld, and this is the voicemail “ File documentation in your case our department has made several attempts to get in contact with you via mail and also phone calls both of which were unsuccessful our client has flagged you as evasive and noncompliant in order to avoid further penalty please contact us immediately at 409-761-7631 again you can press one now to be transferred to a live agent or call us back at 409-761-7631 thank you and good luck”

The sale ended up going thru a platform called SHOP where they tell you your order shipped and use some company called 17TRACK which i have had problems with before - even though this company is in Canada - they show it shipped from China and eventually show it delivered to my employer which NEVER happened and they have never ever answered not one of my 25 or so emails and the phone number does not work and the platform that takes the order says they cannot control what the seller does !  It is not alot of money but it is the principle and i am a senior citizen so to me $10 is alot of money and could have bought a different gift.  They do not even answer messages through their facebook site so they are just a fake storefront taking money.
